highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves image and text processing while strengthening Android, Linux, and WebAssembly support.
highlights_body: It fixes native string and stream lifetime issues, reduces allocations in pixel and shaping paths, and refreshes platform packaging.

bullets.lead: Native string data is copied safely
bullets.detail: FromCString now avoids reading past its native buffer and writes directly into SKData.
Keeps the front buffer alive for the lifetime required by stream consumers.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for steadier presentation.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing allocate less
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed pixel copies and avoids temporary native and UTF-32 encoding buffers when processing image data and HarfBuzz feature strings.

bullets.lead: Linux resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally
bullets.detail: Binds HarfBuzz functions from the bundled native library on Linux rather than relying on external symbol resolution.
Ships emdawnwebgpu's WebGPU implementation inside the WebAssembly native archive.
Raises the supported deployment minimums for Apple platform targets.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Linux-local bundled HarfBuzz binding and browser sample test stabilization
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled WebGPU implementation support for the WebAssembly native library
